# Weyland-Yutani Employee Handbook ## Colonial Office Edition
[color=#a4885c]Weyland-Yutani Corporation. Company employees only. Do not share outside the Company.[/color]
These are the policies and procedures for Weyland-Yutani office staff at colonial sites. Every employee is expected to know them from their first shift.
Breaches of policy are recorded in the employee's personnel file and are reviewed at contract renewal. Serious breaches may result in immediate dismissal.
Where a situation isn't covered by this handbook, staff are to act in the Company's interest and report the matter to the Corporate Liaison.
[italic]Building Better Worlds.[/italic]
